actors.description: Look up Brazilian companies by CNPJ and get the full official record: legal name, address, industry (CNAE), partners/shareholders (QSA), tax regime, and status. Fast, reliable, and cheap

actors.name: enriquecimento-lista-empresas-por-cnpj
actors.title: Consulta CNPJ em Lote - Enriquecimento de Empresas
actors.developer: BrasilDados.org - API e Data as a Service
actors.description: Faça consulta CNPJ em lote e enriqueça até 1.000 empresas brasileiras de uma vez. Receba razão social, nome fantasia, situação cadastral, atividades CNAE, contatos, endereço protegido e quadro societário. Aceita CNPJ com ou sem pontuação e exporta em JSON, CSV ou Excel via Batch ou Standby

actors.name: consulta-sancoes-cpf-cnpj-ceis-cnep-cepim-ceaf
actors.title: Consulta Sanções CPF/CNPJ - CEIS, CNEP, CEPIM, CEAF e Leniência
actors.developer: BrasilDados.org - API e Data as a Service
actors.description: Consulte sanções oficiais de pessoas e empresas no Brasil por CPF ou CNPJ no CEIS, CNEP, CEPIM, CEAF e Acordos de Leniência. Retorne punições, órgãos, processos, datas, fundamentos e situação em JSON pela API em lote, com CPF mascarado e cobrança apenas por sanção encontrada

actors.name: licitacoes-brasil-pncp
actors.title: Licitações Brasil (PNCP) | Editais, Atas & Contratos

actors.name: bikeshop-com-br-bicicletas-catalog-scraper
actors.title: BikeShop Brasil Bicicletas Catalog Scraper
actors.description: Scrapes the full bicycle product catalog from BikeShop.com.br - Brazil's dedicated bike e-commerce retailer. Returns MSRP, sale price, parcelamento (installments), stock status, brand, and category for all SKUs including Oggi, Nathor, and more

actors.name: infojobs-br-scraper
actors.title: InfoJobs Brasil Scraper - Jobs, Salaries, Vagas & Empregos BR
actors.description: Scrape InfoJobs Brasil job postings and vagas de emprego across every Brazilian state. Get title, company, salary range (BRL), CLT/PJ contract, work model (remoto, hibrido, presencial), skills, benefits, education, seniority, dates and full description. Export JSON, CSV, Excel, XML

actors.name: olx-brazil-scraper
actors.title: OLX Brazil Scraper API
actors.description: Scrape classified listings from olx.com.br. Read search or category pages, one row per listing. Each row has the id, title, price in BRL and category. You also get city and state, publish date and image URLs. The row says if the seller is private or a business

actors.name: gupy-io-jobs-scraper
actors.title: Gupy.io Jobs Scraper
actors.description: Fast HTTP-only scraper for Gupy.io, Brazil's largest hiring platform. Extracts full job descriptions, company info, and location data via Gupy's internal API - no browser required

actors.name: paipt-scraper
actors.title: PaiPt Scraper - Portugal Business Directory (Paginas Amarelas)
actors.description: Scrape pai.pt (Portugal's Yellow Pages / Paginas Amarelas business directory) listings. Search by category and location (concelho), or fetch full business profiles by URL. Get names, addresses, phone numbers, emails, websites, categories, opening hours, and coordinates

actors.name: remax-pt-scraper
actors.title: RE/MAX Portugal Scraper - Real Estate Listings
actors.description: Scrape property listings from RE/MAX Portugal (remax.pt), Portugal's largest real estate agency network. Extract prices, areas, energy labels, and agent details for apartments, houses, land, and commercial properties for sale or rent across every district. No login required

actors.name: imovirtual-scraper
actors.title: Imovirtual Scraper - Portuguese Real Estate
actors.description: Scrape Imovirtual.com (Portugal's largest real-estate portal): title, price, price per m2, area, rooms, floor, full address, agency vs private, images and URL, to buy or to rent. Reliable via Imovirtual's data. For real-estate research and lead generation

actors.name: olx-scraper
actors.title: OLX Brazil Scraper - Any Category, Any Keyword
actors.description: Searches any category on olx.com.br - real estate, cars, electronics, anything - and returns priced listings with structured attributes (area, bedrooms, mileage, color, engine) parsed from the site's own detail chips. No seller identity is ever collected
